repo.description:
### Summary

The OpenBao OIDC provider's token endpoint (`identity/oidc/provider/<name>/token`) accepts enabling the `client_credentials` grant for clients of type `public`. Any caller with a `public` client's `client_id` is issued an OIDC ID token.

### Workarounds

Ensure separation of roles; do not specify both `client_type=public` and `client_credentials=true` on a client configuration. For `client_type=public` clients, explicitly set `client_credentials=false`.

### Patches

This is patched in OpenBao v2.7.2. A special v2.6.5 release has been cut but note that v2.6.x series is officially unsupported upstream; please migrate to the v2.7.x series.
repo.summary: OpenBao's OIDC provider issues client credentials access tokens to unauthenticated callers for public clients
